title: Prefer static factory methods to constructors
description: Learn why static factories can be more flexible than constructors.
concept: Static factory methods can have names, can return subtypes, and can avoid creating new objects.

flashcards.question: Why use static factory methods instead of constructors?
flashcards.answer: They can have descriptive names, reuse instances, and return subtypes.

quiz.question: Which benefit does a static factory method provide?
